title: My Potential
summary: An AI platform that helps Madrid high school students find a career path: validated psychology assessments plus real educational data, connected through a RAG pipeline.
problem: Career orientation for teenagers often sits between a generic test and a counselor's gut feeling. Neither connects a psychological profile with the real catalogue of Spanish degrees and vocational programs.
audience: Madrid high school students, counselors and schools running orientation in the classroom.
responsibilities: Built the full product: psychology test engine (Holland RIASEC, Big Five, Personal Preferences), curated catalogue of Spanish university degrees and vocational programs, and an AI pipeline that writes personalized orientation reports.
Ran active demos with several Madrid schools: counselors and students using the platform in class.
Designed a privacy-by-design architecture for GDPR with minors: no student name or email collected or stored.
decisions: Psychology assessments plus curated educational data, not a chatbot guessing careers.
No student PII: orientation for minors without storing name or email.
Rails and Hotwire for the product surface; RAG with Qdrant and OpenAI for the reports.
outcomes: Live classroom demos with counselors and students in Madrid schools.
Personalized career orientation reports generated from assessments and the educational catalogue.
